user.title: NOAA It All Setup
user.description:
Detected Home Assistant Home location: {ha_location}.

If a Home location is configured, latitude and longitude have been pre-filled from your Home Assistant Home zone; otherwise enter them manually. You may override the values to use a different location. The closest NWS forecast office will be suggested in the next step.

office.title: Choose NWS Forecast Office
office.description:
Select the NOAA / NWS forecast office to use for {latitude}, {longitude}. The office NWS names for this location is pre-selected, followed by the nearby coastal offices.

{warning}

surf.title: Choose Surf Forecast Office
surf.description: {office} does not issue a Surf Zone Forecast, so rip current risk, surf height and water temperature come from a coastal office instead. Each office shows what it provides: every one gives rip current risk, but water temperature needs a tide station and surf height a buoy, which some don't have. The nearest is pre-selected; pick another to follow a beach you visit, or choose No surf data to leave those entities out.

error.invalid_office: Please choose a valid NWS forecast office.

abort.already_configured: This NOAA office and location is already configured.

radar.title: Radar Loop History
radar.description:
How many hours of radar the animated Radar Loop should cover.

NOAA's own loop is fixed at roughly 50 minutes and it only keeps ten frames on the server, so anything longer is collected here instead: one frame per refresh, saved under your Home Assistant configuration directory and kept across restarts. A newly configured loop starts short and fills out over the hours that follow.

Expect a few megabytes of storage per radar site, and note that the assembled animation is larger than NOAA's, so every open dashboard re-downloads it each time it changes.

Set 0 to serve NOAA's own loop unchanged and store nothing. Maximum {max_hours} hours.

error.invalid_office: Please choose a valid NWS forecast office.
error.invalid_radar_hours: Radar history must be a whole number of hours between 0 and {max_hours}.
